summary.text: Brenna Barksdale is the Democratic candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 163, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Cathy Loy.
Barksdale works as an assistant manager at a cannabis dispensary and lists public education, workers' benefits and health care funding among her priorities.

paragraphs.text: Brenna Barksdale graduated from Carthage High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Missouri Southern State University in 2013.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Barksdale said she has lived in Southwest Missouri for most of her life and worked at area Family Video stores while attending Missouri Southern.
She described her current job as assistant manager at a cannabis dispensary.
Barksdale advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026, with no opponent on the ballot.
In the survey, she said she supports quality public education for all students, including students with special needs, and better pay for teachers.

She criticized the legislature's repeal of the earned paid sick time provisions voters approved as Proposition A in 2024, and said she would fund Medicaid expansion and then work toward a single-payer, Medicare for All system.
She also said she supports policies that make groceries, housing and health care affordable, and more sidewalks leading to community gathering spaces.
